# ÐMaps + ÐLand (Dogecoin)

Canonical public spec: https://github.com/jonheaven/dmaps
License: MIT

Status (see also README.md Start here, and AGENTS.md):
- Anchors (real-world land claims) are fully on-chain Dogecoin inscriptions that spend the parcel title UTXO. There is no centralized DB. Any conformant indexer recomputes identical state from the chain and docs/INDEXING.md. The Dogex HTTP API is a read convenience, not authority.
- End-to-end: current title holder broadcasts a committed ÐLand op:"anchor" reveal that spends the title satpoint; after confirmation every indexer applies the same rules; occupation is a chain fact, optionally read via GET /api/land/cell/{h3} or compared via checkpoint hashes.
- ÐMaps v0.1 title rules and official H3 4.2.1 cells are specified in this repo.
- ÐLand v0.1 is a Launch Draft with complete rules, schemas, and worked vectors. Marker: p="Ð:LAND".
- Mainnet and testnet activation heights are reserved (null in docs/INDEXING.md) until a dated revision announces them. Regtest activates at 0. A live mainnet index is empty until then.
- This repo is spec, docs, schemas, vectors, and reference JavaScript. It does not include indexer source.
- Standing/1 and neighbor counts are non-consensus and are not in the checkpoint hash.

## Protocols
- ÐMaps, p="Ð:MAPS", v0.1: protocols/dogemaps/spec.md
  FCFS title per block_height. Derived H3 overlay (default res 9) from SHA256d of DOGEMAPS/1/GEO/block_height=N/h3_res=R/ then H3 4.2.1 latLngToCell.
  Official cells: (0,9)=89e98d184b7ffff (1,9)=8901a2b054fffff (12345,8)=88f166ced3fffff
- ÐLand, p="Ð:LAND", Launch Draft v0.1: protocols/dland/spec.md
  pack (permissionless, id=inscription id); build (holder-gated, travels with title, supersede/remove/seal); anchor (chosen H3 res 12, unique, commit-first W=30, reanchor cooldown 144).
  Authorization: committed reveal AND spend of current title UTXO. No leftover signatures after transfer.
  District=parent res 7 (Founder badge); Region=parent res 4. Not legal property.

## Indexing (must be identical across implementations)
- docs/INDEXING.md — order, validity, reorg, activation constants (mainnet/testnet null until announced; regtest 0), dmaps-checkpoint/1, SHA-256
- vectors/indexer-state.json — expected checkpoint_hash after each abstract block
- reference/apply.mjs, reference/checkpoint.mjs, reference/dmaps-geo.mjs
- Standing/1 (protocols/dland/standing.mjs) is non-consensus; not in the checkpoint

## HTTP (Dogex — read convenience, not authority)
- docs/API.md, docs/openapi.yaml
- Endpoints: /api/doginals/dogemaps/claims, /r/dogemap/block/{block}, /api/land/parcel/{block}, /packs, /builds, /anchors, /cell/{h3}, /district/{h3}, /region/{h3}, /holder/{address}, /api/dmaps/checkpoint/{height}

## Primer
- docs/h3.md — what H3 is, resolution table, derived vs chosen cells, h3-js 4.2.1 examples

## Out of scope in the normative specs
- pack_claim, tithes, or reputation discounts (not specified)
- Mixing ÐMaps derived cells with ÐLand pins
- Treating anchors as deeds
- Indexer source, secrets, or .env files (not in this repository)
